channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: Spain demands Israel release arrested Gaza flotilla crew member
item.description: Spanish authorities demanded Israel release Saif Abukeshek, a Gaza flotilla crew member, after he was taken into custody during a raid off the Greek coast. Abukeshek was among those detained by Israeli forces.

item.title: Police arrest suspect over poisoned HiPP baby food
item.description: Austrian police arrested a 39-year-old man suspected of attempting to blackmail a German baby food manufacturer by contaminating HiPP baby food. The suspect's alleged involvement led to the arrest. A 39-year-old man has been arrested in Austria for his alleged involvement in an attempt to blackmail a German baby food manufacturer.

item.title: Devastation of Southern Lebanon continues under ‘ceasefire’
item.description: At least 41 people were killed in southern Lebanon as Israel launched 50 airstrikes in 24 hours. The attacks continued despite a reported ceasefire. At least 41 people killed as Israel launches 50 airstrikes on southern Lebanon in 24 hours.

item.title: Leclerc rows back from 'harsh' criticism of Antonelli's driving
item.description: Charles Leclerc softened his criticism of Antonio Antonelli's driving after initially calling it harsh. Leclerc's comments followed a collision between the two drivers in a recent racing event. Leclerc rows back from 'harsh' criticism of Antonelli's driving.

item.title: Oil tanker hijacked off coast of Yemen and taken towards Somalia
item.description: An oil tanker was hijacked off the coast of Yemen and taken towards Somalia, the second such incident in the area in 10 days. The hijacking raised concerns about maritime security in the region.

item.title: Drone kills 2 in Kherson minibus strike, as Russia claims front-line progress
item.description: A drone strike on a minibus in Kherson killed 2 people. Russia claimed progress on the front lines. Drone kills 2 in Kherson minibus strike, as Russia claims front-line progress.

item.title: NATO is trying to "understand the details" of the US decision to withdraw troops from Germany
item.description: NATO is reviewing the US decision to withdraw troops from Germany. Details are being assessed. NATO is trying to "understand the details" of the US decision to withdraw troops from Germany Українські Національні Новини (УНН).

item.title: Nobel laureate Mohammadi's life in Iran's hands, Nobel committee chief says
item.description: The Nobel committee chief said Iran controls Nobel laureate Mohammadi's life. His situation is uncertain. Nobel laureate Mohammadi's life in Iran's hands, Nobel committee chief says.

item.title: Banksy confirms new statue installed in central London is his work
item.description: Banksy confirmed a new statue in London is his work. It depicts a man hoisting a flag. The statue in Waterloo Place, which appeared early Wednesday, depicts a man proudly hoisting a flag.

item.title: Relief for Howe as Newcastle end losing run with win over Brighton
item.description: Newcastle ended their losing run with a win over Brighton. Howe's team secured a much-needed victory. Relief for Howe as Newcastle end losing run with win over Brighton.

item.title: Yemen reports hijacked oil tanker headed for Somalia
item.description: Yemen reported a hijacked oil tanker heading for Somalia, the fourth vessel hijacking near Somalia in recent weeks. The incident marks at least the fourth vessel hijacking near Somalia in recent weeks.

item.title: Spain’s Sanchez demands Netanyahu free Spaniard seized on aid flotilla
item.description: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez demanded Israel release a Spaniard seized on an aid flotilla. Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez is demanding Israel to release the 'abducted' Spaniard taken from the flotilla.

item.title: Airlines scramble to help stranded Spirit passengers after budget carrier collapses
item.description: Airlines are helping stranded Spirit passengers after the budget carrier collapsed. Airlines scramble to help stranded Spirit passengers after budget carrier collapses.

item.title: Taiwan president visits Eswatini days after blaming China for cancelled trip
item.description: Taiwan's president visited Eswatini after blaming China for a cancelled trip, with China describing it as a "stowaway-style escape". It is unclear how he reached Eswatini. China described his visit as a "stowaway-style escape farce".

item.title: Kostyuk downs Andreeva to claim Madrid Open title
item.description: Kostyuk won the Madrid Open title by defeating Andreeva. Kostyuk downs Andreeva to claim Madrid Open title.

item.title: Prices surge, jobs disappear as war strains Iran’s economy
item.description: Iran's economy struggles as war causes prices to surge and jobs to disappear under New Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei. New Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei says the country must defeat its enemies in an economic and cultural struggle, as we.

item.title: Thirteen killed in Israeli strikes on southern Lebanon, health ministry says
item.description: Thirteen people were killed in Israeli strikes on southern Lebanon. Four women and a child were among the dead. Four women and a child are among the dead, as fighting between Israel and Iran-backed Hezbollah continues despite a ceasefire.

item.title: Mexican governor indicted by US steps down
item.description: Sinaloa Governor Ruben Rocha Moya stepped down after being indicted by the US. He was accused of protecting the Sinaloa cartel and taking millions in bribes. Sinaloa Governor Ruben Rocha Moya has been accused of protecting the powerful Sinaloa cartel and helping it smuggle drugs into the US, allegedly taking in millions of dollars in bribes.

item.title: Dutch Princesses Targeted In Chilling 'Nazi' Murder Plot
item.description: A suspect had a note with the names of Dutch Princesses Amalia and Alexia and the word "bloodbath". Suspect had a handwritten note with the words "Amalia", "Alexia" and "bloodbath".

item.title: Germany says US troop withdrawal 'foreseeable' as Nato seeks clarification
item.description: German Defence Minister Boris Pistorius expects the US to withdraw 5,000 troops from Germany. German Defence Minister Boris Pistorius said the US decision to withdraw 5,000 troops was to be expected.
